notes.title: Beerman App Updated on Microsoft App Store!
notes.notes:
The Boston Madness sees a second release on the Microsoft App Store!

What took you so long? I hear the question...

A long time ago in a far off but very clear nightmare I released the first version on the UWP application on the Microsoft Store which was a huge lift for me then. Shortly there after another huge lift in the form of university put the brakes on everything and plunged me into a coding nightmare of survival.

In the midst of this carnage as I watched countless other students fall around me and get eaten by huge university demands an error in the second level of the first app    ( When Beerman got battered by Team Geriatric and fell over the bloody level wouldn't end and Malcolm was left running around the store screaming unintelligibly with a rake )   saw me scramble to get the Android App fixed on Amazon but alas due to the time constraints I couldn't reach out to fix the UWP app on [url=https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/p/beerman/9mx5g3mcvj3k?activetab=pivot:overviewtab]Windows.....why?[/url]

Because fixing things for UWP which needs work across multitudes of systems is a beast!

How much so... well lets run this by you, I figured this whole build would be over in 3 weeks....

Week 1 : Weekend attempt at fixing app and starting build..... failure

Week 2 : Weekend attempt at figuring out why over 3 days I couldn't start..... failure

Week 3 : Weekend attempt at ...... get the idea?

In between these weeks  :
 
madness   
depression  
resignation to failure  
possible psychopathy
more screaming and uncontrolled anger
 considering admitting defeat and going off to....

Week 10 : Several Unity upgrades and several UWP Builds and the first attempt at uploading the finished article to Microsoft Store Complete..... 

Beerman_1.1.5.0_x86_x64_arm_bundle_Master.appxupload   
= 25.3 Gigabytes
                                             
Week 11 : Second attempt at uploading the finished article to Microsoft Store Complete..... 

Beerman_1.1.7.0_x64_arm_bundle_Master.appxupload          
= 17.7 Gigabytes

Week 12 : Third attempt at uploading the finished article to Microsoft Store Complete..... 

 Beerman_1.1.8.0_x64_bundle_Master.appxupload                 
= 10.1 Gigabytes

There are now 53.1 Gigabytes of Boston Madness uploaded and on station on the Windows Microsoft App Store!

its quite cool how they work, you don't erase the one before if it works, instead you add each successful build and the system when someone tries to download makes a copy of the game from the build their Windows Device accepts trying the x64 first then if that isn't acceptable the x64 ARM and finally if their device is older the x86 x64 ARM.....mine wouldn't accept the larger first two and forced me to upload the third 1.1.8.0_x64 before it would accept it!

You then get a much smaller game build downloaded to your device in Beerman's case 1.91 Gigabytes!

Windows like to do things big!

Andoid App = 385 Megabytes

Windows UWP - 1.91 Gigabytes

Wow!

Anyway that's my explanation as clearly as I can explain for anyone who was bewildered as to why one was fixed and not the other at the time.....the short answer is because I can't pull 12 weekends in a row out of my Ah huh hoo lets keep this a family show now lol.

Now about this nomination thingy...my as described above nightmare might qualify Beerman but that's all Tech Dev speak and might not float everyone's boat so the game would have to do what it always does and make folks laugh.....and some cry   ːsteamhappyː

So to that end the Beerman Website has had an update where the gang have been let loose one more time across the page to bring a laugh to everyones phone or desktop...

Yes weeks of cutting let me send them tearing over the screen and I even made sure a ninth gunner emerges from the van roof to show they are animating and the wheels are turning as its hard to see  on mobile but the desktop proves they have their wheels and no corners where cut!

notes.title: Beerman App Updated to Bundle!
notes.notes:
Well its finally been done! After tirelessly working back and forth over months the VS1 Studios staff   ( Me ) figured out how to change Beerman from an APK to a Bundle.

Not as easy as you might think after a lot of time away from developing due to the real world demanding I work.

Anyway after picking up where I left off I had to figure out how far up the Unity Archive I had to take... could take Beerman to be able to generate a Bundle that websites are beginning to insist on.

After finding the right Archive year of Unity then going through over a dozen of that year then cracking up as each time you increase the Unity year and upgrade the game to that year another tire falls off the car or the exhaust blows up or some damn thing that you then have to go back in and fix Aaaaarrrrgghh!!!

Now why is this being done I hear the haters ask incredulously! Well there is the serious development side of upgrading to 64 bit and that means Beerman is compliant with app providers but also there is something else..... The rules of those there competitions state that your game has to have been built or upgraded within the last year and of course they say   "Game"   not which version of the game, so Beerman now technically qualifies and can be entered into competitions with this new upgrade!

Also there have been many sprite upgrades including the unfortunate ones that had words written backwards and stuff.....you know the ones.

So when is the Steam Game being updated with the same? Its on the list and really i'm waiting for Unity to put the Unity 4 Archive series on the Unity Hub because the Hub doesn't like you starting a stand alone Unity without its say so and so id have to dismantle all that hugeness to do that.

Luckily the Beerman App was made after the original Beerman Steam Game so the app was made in a later Unity version,  Unity 5 which is the current Archive the hub stopped adding at so still waiting on them getting down to Unity 4 for the original Steam game ....wow Unity 4 sooooooooo long ago.

More updates to follow soon, yep haters, still here!

notes.title: The Beerman Interview
notes.notes:
A great fan of the game and one of it's biggest supporters launched a steam group called :

THE FLAMING NETWORK

[url=http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25872138/b1ee1bf4e418c46b6181b020f517174f9bab058a.png][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25872138/5a64f1f98ce668d7b424cefef4c93e765c5a87c2.png[/img][/url]
http://steamcommunity.com/groups/flamingnetwork#


This fantastic group gave Beerman the chance of an interview to explain the madness of it's origins and where it came from.....what follows is that fun outtake offering laughs and explanations for the fans which can be downloaded here :

https://1drv.ms/u/s!AthsCUt5GHHInX5h3DzAem44vq2A

 

Beerman Interview


1.

Interviewer	:	So how did the idea for Beerman Develop?

VS1Toronto	:	The first day of university one of the lecturers said words to the 					effect of “Take the leash off your brain and write down the first 					thing that appears…”

I wrote down an irritable aging superhero who hurled beercans at 	people and if you pushed button “A” gave abuse to the nearest 	person! 


2.

Interviewer	:	Why is he in such an irritated mood all the time?

VS1Toronto	:	The game is a reflection of my own mental state at the time I’ve 					discovered, I was a taxi driver, over nine years nightshift in the 					murder capital of Europe for the last 70 years running, (Glasgow , 				Scotland ).

Nine years of listening to human beings at their worst gets you 		down and eventually you turn into quite a nasty piece of work, you 	don’t notice because it’s such a gradual process but eventually I 	realised I couldn’t carry all this anger towards human beings around 	or it would poison my life.


3.

Interviewer	:	So you made a game about a city under siege from nasty people?

VS1Toronto	:	Yep I had two choices I reckoned, either pour all the angst and anger 				that had built up into a computer game…..or….a spree kill! And 					there are certain legal conotations attached to spree kills that I 					wanted to avoid.


4.

Interviewer	:	So why Boston? 

VS1Toronto	:	I needed a good American state that understood alcohol, and so why 				not the most Irish piece of land outside Ireland…..Boston!


5.

Interviewer	:	What’s the Mexican connection?

VS1Toronto	:	Well I needed a country that was into the powdered snack game for 				the storyline.


6.

Interviewer	:	Why did Mexico occur to you first?

VS1Toronto	:	My dad lives in Arizona just over the border so it cropped up in 					conversation from time to time, that and the real life greatest 					Mexican export kind of kept it front in my mind…..Salma Hayek.


7.

Interviewer	:	So did you start making Beerman right after that first day at 						university?

VS1Toronto	:	No it was triggered two years later after my last night in the taxi.


8.

Interviewer	:	What triggered it?

VS1Toronto	:	The second last night in the taxi I ended up in the country side after 				dropping a passenger really far out and the whole sky was clouded 				over a weird sort of silver grey colour and the only part that wasn’t 				was a small oval shape with the three stars of “Orion’s Belt “looking 				down at me at three in the morning.

I ended up stopping the car, getting out and just staring at it for 	about two minutes, I’d never seen anything like that in nearly ten 	years, I couldn’t stop looking at it.

Anyway the next night, the last night was mind numbingly boring 	apart from the last passenger who was an amateur games developer, 	he told me about “Google Play” and how you could get games 	published on it etc…then he started complaining about how difficult 	larger games where to make before going really quiet for a while…

Sitting at four in the morning at a red light with the rain pouring 	down he just suddenly blurted out loudly “TO HELL WITH THOSE 	THREE STAR GAMES I WOULD NEVER MAKE ONE OF 	THEM!

And I just saw those three stars of Orion’s Belt glaring down at me 	through that oval in the sky from the night before in my imagination 	and thought “Right right ok I hear you…don’t burn out my retinas 	from the back with this memory” It was so vivid…I started making 	Beerman the next night.


9.

Interviewer	:	So are you saying you think Beerman is a three star game?

VS1Toronto	:	Oh no it was another game called “Croc Runner” that was the three 				star game I was thinking about…..Beerman was supposed to be just 				one level, the first level, that let me experiment and learn how to 				make games and then take that knowledge on to “Croc Runner”.

But then Beerman developed arms and legs and characters and a 	storyline and just morphed into a whole game in my head all by 	itself!….It was weird and bonkers and so much fun lol. 


10.

Interviewer	:	And why is Toronto mentioned a lot, is it true the second Beerman 				game is set there?

VS1Toronto	:	In real life Toronto has a large Jamaican population so it makes 					sense since as guess who’s going to be a big part of the second one!

I had a holiday a long time back in Toronto and fell in love with 		Canada and it’s people.

If aliens arrived tomorrow and demanded I bring them an example 	of the greatest achievement humans have made so far I’d bring 		them a Canadian…..or maybe Salma Hayek…..no no…a 		Canadian..a 	Canadian lol.


11.

Interviewer	:	There’s a lot of Jamaican baddies in it, why is that? 

VS1Toronto	:	Well growing up in the Eighties we had Mr Steven Seagal’s action 				films, some people liked them some didn’t but what noone could 				deny was they had the coolest baddies ever to grace the television 				screen…..THE JAMAICANS!….They do bad sooooooo good!

I needed some fun cool hitmen in my game so why not!


12.

Interviewer	:	What’s the story with Vegan Bob? 

VS1Toronto	:	Well something happened in the taxi which caused the inspiration 				for Vegan Bob…..I tried to go vegetarian for a few days…..


13.

Interviewer	:	You did what!

VS1Toronto	:	Ssshhhhhh shhhhhh….just keep it between us…..I’m not proud of it 				and it was only once and I’ll never do it again I swear!


14.

Interviewer	:	What made you try it? 

VS1Toronto	:	Well you hear this garbage coming over the radio, give up real food 				just eat lettuce and cheese and your life will change, up will come 				the sun, down will go your credit card and all sorts of other 						rubbish….

But you hear it so many times it get’s into your head and you 	eventually think maybe i’m missing out on something so you try it.


15.

Interviewer	:	What happened? 

VS1Toronto	:	The first two days were ok, you slept better and felt healthy, that 				must be all the toxins leaving your system…..but on day three my 				brain started falling apart…..of course it did, you need amino acids 				and glucose to feed it and you can’t get that from vegetables alone!


16.

Interviewer	:	What do you mean your brain fell apart? 

VS1Toronto	:	I couldn’t concentrate, a thought would come in do a loop around 				my head then disappear, my brain no longer had the fuel to hold on 				to them…..and it was really badly affecting my ability to drive!

Stopping at a set of traffic lights with two passengers arguing in the 	back I remember looking up at the red light in a tired haze and then 	this thought suddenly appeared in my head…..
“Is that red light really…..as red as we think it is!”

These people behind me were depending on me for their safety! And 	I couldn’t tell whether a traffic light was red or not!

That did it, after I dropped off the passengers I went straight to the 	nearest road van fast food seller and bought the most disgusting, 	grease dripping horrificly unhealthy cheese burger you’ve ever seen 	and almost immediately my body woke back up!

Yep that’s why the cheese burgers are in the game.

I also had a thought as I was munching down the burger, What 	would happen if you were forced to go vegetarian?

Well your brain would stop functioning correctly and you would end 	up acting and talking all bonkers and crazy just like real life 	vegetarians!

Then I thought what would happen if it was taken a stage further and 	you were forced to go Vegan? My goodness…..you would go 	INSANE!

And VEGAN BOB was born!


17.

Interviewer	:	So is there sort of hidden suggestions that large food companies are 				trying to poison us?

VS1Toronto	:	Em……..can’t answer that after what the large food companies tried 				to do to Oprah Winfrey. 


18.

Interviewer	:	What did they do? 

VS1Toronto	:	They tried to tear her a new one after she suggested their food was 				full of dangerous health harming additives…..in the event her legal 				council “Dr Phil” ended up tearing them a new one!


19.

Interviewer	:	So is GM food dangerous?

VS1Toronto	:	Depends if you think dying 20 years before you need to and 						suffering all sorts of allergies and health complaints before that 					untimely death is dangerous?


20.

Interviewer	:	Why would GM food be dangerous?

VS1Toronto	:	Humans have evolved over millions of years to work symbiotically 				with bacteria to brake down food in their guts with their help.

GM food has almost no bacteria inside to help it survive better 	outdoors and be resistant to pests and the elements.

With almost no bacteria in the food it means your body has to do all 	the work digesting it and your DNA takes twice the amount of 		damage it should translating into the breakdown of your health.


21.

Interviewer	:	Is there any proof of this?

VS1Toronto	:	Apart from all the scientists screaming online who are being hushed 				up, France has just banned modified corn flour…..completely…..I 				wonder why…..Vive La France!


22.

Interviewer	:	Why would companies be trying to sell it if they know it’s 						dangerous? 

VS1Toronto	:	Because by the time they figured out just how dangerous and life 				ruining it is they had invested Billions and Billions in the research 				and they want those Billions back…..even if it means poisoning the 				world in the process!


23.

Interviewer	:	Beerman had a shaky start how did it ever get through Greenlight? 

VS1Toronto	:	I hatched a plan to see how far up the 2200 odd titles I could get by 				attaching a Beerman App which linked to the Beerman website 					which linked to the then Steam Greenlight page. I never actually 				expected it to get released it was an enormous surprise!


24.

Interviewer	:	Was there any truth to a certain Argentinian publicity company 					helping out by advertising Beerman on radio shows and the web.

VS1Toronto	:	Em…………………no comment lol.


25.

Interviewer	:	Without claiming it happened, why did people go to these extremes 				on Greenlight? 

VS1Toronto	:	Greenlight ended up a great trainer for real life, in that at the end it 				was more corrupt than WALL STREET! In fact it could have 					taught those guys a thing or two and eventually you realised unless 				you do what everybody else is doing your never going to get 					anywhere.

If there’s only one honest race car on the race track then you can be 	sure it will be that race car that loses!

If everyone else is fighting dirty then you have no choice. 

If you don’t fight then you have no reason to complain!


26.

Interviewer	:	Talking about fighting what happened to cause that bust up between 				you and the Greenlight trolls?		 

VS1Toronto	:	Well I put up with intergalactic levels of abuse, principally because 				I’m almost twice their age and didn’t think I should really be 					shouting back at people in their youth, I didn’t think that was fair or 				would have put myself in a good light so I just stood back and let 				them get on with it and tried to take what I could constructively 					from their generations opinions and adjust the game accordingly.

I’m a different generation so things have moved on in the gaming 	world and I had to take that into account.
That changed however when the usual Troll brigade attacked a 		Mexican High School.

The game was called “Ducks in Space”.

It was a great beginners submission and you saw the comments of 	the hopeful school team as they politely asked the opinions of the 	audience in a very cheerful and hopeful manner…..

What followed from the Trolls who inhabited Greenlight was one of 	the most shocking examples of sustained verbal vitriol I have ever 	seen and speaks in the most negative terms of their parents, their 	poor upbringing and their standards of form therein…..

The unceasing abuse lasted days and the poor high school team 		never answered back once and you could tell they were stunned at 	the poisonous response from these “bastards” and that they’re
dreams had just been squashed after all they’re hard work.

I myself finally started remonstrating with these slime ball 		Greenlight Trolls and after some heated exchange over their 		shocking behaviour decided to go to a group called “The Duck 		Society” and inform them of what was happening.

I posted a message to the affect of “Attention All Ducks, Attention 	All Ducks some of you fellow hatchlings are under attack from 	Greenlight trolls come and help them out, all ducks to battle!” and 	included the Greenlight address link.

Well a few of the ducks did come running through with the attitude 	“Heah heah noone get’s to push ducks around on here, you yeah you! 	You pushing a duck? Come ere!…..

It sounds silly now but what wasn’t silly was the abuse the poor 	Mexicans were taking and the ducks really helped out.

I hope they went on with their game because it did look really good, 	ducks all flying around in their own personal space ships conquering 	space!

https://1drv.ms/u/s!AthsCUt5GHHInX5h3DzAem44vq2A

 

Beerman Interview

VS1Toronto	:	The first day of university one of the lecturers said words to the 					effect of “Take the leash off your brain and write down the first 					thing that appears…”

3.

4.

VS1Toronto	:	I needed a good American state that understood alcohol, and so why 				not the most Irish piece of land outside Ireland…..Boston!

VS1Toronto	:	Well I needed a country that was into the powdered snack game for 				the storyline.

notes.title: Beerman Playable App Launched on Android and Windows
notes.notes:
Yes it's finally happened the Boston Mayhem has been reconfigured to run on a mobile phone both in Android hosted by Amazon App Store and Windows hosted by Windows App Store.

The process to convert it from the PC supported Unity Steam version to the Android / Windows UWP version was incredibly difficult, how hard I hear you ask?  I'll have nightmares about converting every Polyon Collider thoughout the game to Box Colliders till the end of time!!!

Initially I was not going to announce it because I didn't want to annoy the good people at Steam who took a chance on this game, and was just going to quietly work on it in the background.

However it turns out in order to make it run on an app I had to scale down the first level a bit, things like the glass coming out of windows now just disappears on the way down rather than hitting the ground and being removed by the coroners van, quirky little touches like that had to be removed or slimmed down.

Fortunately the rest of the game levels are almost identical and the video cut scenes which are completely identical so the whole point of the game - The Storyline - remains the same.

That then means Steam still hold the fastest PC supported version with all the trimmings for the hardcore gamers out there and now that the Beerman Website has had it's contacts page reconfigured to include the app addresses a new customer base is potentially on route to them.

Anyone who finds the game on Amazon App Store or on the Windows App Store will inevitably find the attached Beerman Website and since all the game buttons in the website are and will remain targeted at the Steam Website a whole bunch of folks who might not have frequented Steam will now be directed here.

So there are three winners from this process then :

1. Steam win by getting unofficial advertising on their rivals websites through the Beerman Website directing a new bunch of folks to them.

2. The fans win by getting news of one more step on this mad Boston journey.

3. And I win by getting to laugh at all the old Greenlight haters who said this game was never going to go anywhere one more time.....

notes.title: Beerman Latest Update
notes.notes:
This update concerns level 1 and all of the odd things that needed ironed out, I would have got to it sooner but some evil lecturers insisted I do their coursework first.....details below :

Level 1 Updates


1. Drunk Missiles

    Yes unfortunately Jamaican George's launchings did tend to drift under the helicopter as if they had been drinking.....well no longer, now the missiles launched head directly for Beerman or the helicopters nose.............Jamaican George got his aim back!


2. Beerman Blasted

    It was the strange case that even with Beerman's Vietnam experience if he inadvertently smashed into another helicopter there was the possibility of him literally being blasted clear of the game screen in the resulting explosion.....this has now been fixed with it truly impossible for our hero to go AWOL.


3. Magic JaMan

    In the previous builds when JaMan was preparing to throw the student to his death from the top of the building if the player was quick enough and opened the chinook ramp and killed the two guards JaMan would also be seen walking onto the aircraft with the Veggie Baddie.....

    Now although JaMan is Jamaican and therefore cool enough to be in two places at once this didn't really sit well with reality so I have since revised this and now the chinook door will not open for boarding until JaMan has finished throwing the student to his death.....

Hooray for order! ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Controller Support Added!!!
notes.notes:
Beerman now has in game controller support!

There is still a need to use the mouse to operate Unity's configuration launcher and to use the Beerman game menu but all levels now have controller support once they are started, details below :


For Xbox controller :

Left, Right, Up, Down controlled by Left Stick

Left, Right, Up, Down also controlled by Dpad

Fire button controlled by Y button


For Play Station controller :

Left, Right, Up, Down controlled by Left Stick

Left, Right, Up, Down also controlled by Dpad

Fire button controlled by A button



Fire buttons may vary based on individual internal controller architecture.

ALL CONTROLS ARE ADJUSTABLE FROM Unity configuration launcher
details below :

Left click the "input" tab on the Unity configuration launcher.

Then "double left click" on a control you wish to change.

Then either pull the control stick or push the button you wish to change.

notes.title: Beerman levels updated.
notes.notes:
My thanks to all who've played and let me know your thoughts, your insights have been invaluable, thank you.

One of the hardest things I found was setting just how challenging to make the levels as my views aren't much good for that as I know what's about to happen and where to be when it does.

Since the storyline is the point of the game and making people laugh and enjoy themselves at the various characters antics as they play through the Beerman World I didn't want to block the story progression by making the levels too challenging but was nervous about making them too easy and leaving people with no challenge at all.

I tried to set the first three levels easy to introduce the characters then make the levels progressively harder but I got it a bit wrong.

The consensus from everyone was that in general the levels where too hard and so I have adjusted them in various ways to hopefully give players a more enjoyable experience and a progression through the story.

My thanks again to all and I hope you have fun and enjoy the show.
